editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood spot where Cajun flavors and BBQ meet, run with genuine passion by folks who care about every plate.
editorial.insiderTip: Skip the fried rice and lean into what they do best—order the Cajun shrimp or blackened catfish with rice and beans; the Cajun side of the menu is where their heart truly is.
signatureDishes: Blackened catfish with rice and beans
